It runs Praxis filter pipelines (header/body inspection, mutation, rejection, guardrails, AWS SigV4 signing, policy engine, OpenAI Responses filters) as an external processor alongside Envoy/Istio gateways. Cargo.toml defines a single binary target (src/bin/praxis_extproc.rs, publish = false), and the source tree includes server.rs, handlers.rs, health.rs, metrics.rs and tls.rs. The repo ships a Containerfile/Dockerfile.konflux plus kustomize manifests with a Deployment, Service and ConfigMap (deploy/base/instance, deploy/base/config), with overlays for openshift/odh.
